name: finopsx
description: FinOpsX — conceptual AI-powered financial operations and intelligence platform using synthetic data.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @finopsx/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finopsx/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build:seed
scripts.test: npm run build -w @finopsx/shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
